output.summary: A genus of shrubs and vines native to tropical and warm-temperate Asia, Africa and Oceania. Its roughly 200 species may be evergreen or deciduous and are best remembered for usually fragrant white or yellow flowers, with reddish blooms rare.
output.edibilityNote: Some Jasminum species are used to produce teas and herbal infusions; J. sambac flowers scent green, white or sometimes oolong tea.
